name: Wave:3
author: abduldotdev
description: Keeps an Elgato Wave:3 USB microphone as the always-working default input: pins its profile and priority in WirePlumber, re-defaults it when it reappears, and adds a bar icon with a controls popup for mic gain, mute, headphone volume and a live input level meter.

barWidget.description: Elgato Wave:3 mic status with a controls popup (gain, mute, headphone volume, level meter) and right-click reset
